subject: SIGN clause (representation when PICTURE contains character 'S' with no optional SIGN clause)
notes: DOCUMENTED (kb/Work PB803, owner decision 2026-09-09: "Keep both behind an option with the default being IBM and Micro Focus compatibility"). This row did not exist -- docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7's A.1 table jumped 171 to 179 -- and the golden lane had correctly REFUSED to write a witness for it, because a golden pinning `12L` while no determination was filed would have pinned an undocumented choice as though it were documented. The row now states the position (TRAILING for a no-SIGN-clause item), both conventions with their tables and their surveyed provenance, the option that selects them, the default, the implementing sites, and the INTERCHANGE CONSEQUENCE that the option's existence creates: the convention is a property of the COMPILED PROGRAM, so two programs of one run unit may differ, nothing records the convention of a data file, and a mismatch is silent (a record holding `123t` read by an `ibm` program yields +1230). The escape for data that must cross a convention boundary is SIGN IS SEPARATE, whose characters 13.18.52.4 GR6 b) pins with no latitude.
